function.name: query_database

args.sql:
SELECT a.name AS agent_name,
       SUM((s.output->'usage'->>'total_tokens')::bigint) AS total_tokens
FROM agents a
JOIN runs r ON r.agent_id = a.id
JOIN steps s ON s.run_id = r.id
WHERE r.created_at < '2026-10-28'
  AND s.node = 'think'
  AND s.output->'usage'->>'total_tokens' IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY a.name
ORDER BY a.name;
